clips.title: The story
paras: The severed head of Edwin VanCleef serves as grim, irrefutable proof that the leader of the Defias Brotherhood has fallen. Brought back from the depths of the Deadmines to Sentinel Hill, it represents the hard-won vengeance of the People's Militia.

For months, Edwin VanCleef directed the Defias Brotherhood's terror from the deepest sanctum of the Deadmines, shielded by heavily armed outlaws, goblin engineers, and a massive war juggernaut. Words alone could never convince the battered settlers of Westfall that their nightmare was over. Gryan Stoutmantle, leader of the People's Militia, demanded undeniable physical proof before declaring the countryside safe. Severing the ringleader's head and bringing it out into the daylight offers the exhausted defenders tangible assurance that the grand architect of their ruin will never threaten Westfall again.
